name: Lay The Prince
source:
Following the events of "[url=/v37179]Slay the Princess[/url]", a similar narrative unfolds. A Hero and a Prince are trapped in a condemned time loop, forced to repeat the same encounter again and again.

In this story, you are the Hero, tasked with laying the Prince to avert the doom of humanity. Will you be able to fulfill your task? Or will you defy the story?

[From [url=https://logax52.itch.io/lay-the-prince-concept-demo]itch.io[/url]]
